sota_findings.model_type: LSTM trained with Brier score loss function
sota_findings.technique: Direct Brier-loss optimization during training (not just eval). Dropout=0.5 + L2 regularization. Elo ratings + seed differentials + GLM team-quality features. Early stopping on validation loss. LSTM+Brier outperformed LSTM+BCE (0.1617) and Transformer+Brier (0.1609).
sota_findings.domain: NCAA college basketball (not NBA) — directly applicable methodology
sota_findings.fleet_relevance: CRITICAL — KEY INSIGHT: using Brier score as the training loss (not just eval metric) is the standout 2025 innovation. Our xgboost_brier model type uses eval_metric='brier_score' but may still train with log-loss objective. Switch to objective='binary:logistic' + custom Brier loss gradient could yield similar gains. For GPU bursts (LSTM on Colab/Modal), train with Brier loss directly.

sota_findings.model_type: Logistic Regression (best tabular baseline); LSTM+MC-Dropout (headline model)
sota_findings.technique: Monte Carlo dropout at inference for calibrated uncertainty. Rolling-form indicators. Spatial shot-chart heatmap embeddings. Strict chronological train/val/test split (<=2022/2023/2024). Kelly-criterion decision layer for betting. ECE/MCE calibration evaluation. SHAP interpretability.
sota_findings.fleet_relevance: HIGH — LR baseline at 0.199 is confirmed NBA ceiling for tabular models. LSTM+MC-Dropout likely 0.19x. Spatial shot-chart heatmaps + rolling-form velocity features are not in our current feature set (features/engine.py). Shot chart data available via NBA API.

sota_findings.model_type: CNN (best Brier among 13 models); Stacking ensemble best accuracy
sota_findings.technique: Multi-model benchmark (13 models: MLP, LR, Ridge, XGBoost, LSTM, Bagging, Stacking, AdaBoost, SVM, KNN, NaiveBayes, CNN). Stacking with MLP meta-learner. Chronological split. CNN best Brier (0.221) vs MLP (0.225) vs LR (0.223) vs XGBoost (0.222).
sota_findings.fleet_relevance: MEDIUM — Our fleet best 0.22062 (extra_trees) already approaches CNN 0.221 benchmark. CNN beats XGBoost on Brier which is encouraging for tree-based approach. Stacking MLP meta-learner could improve 0.22062 slightly.

fleet_gap_summary.context: Fleet best 0.22062 is ALREADY competitive with 2025 CNN benchmark (0.221). The remaining gap to <0.20 target requires either: (a) tabular LR/LSTM with MC-dropout, or (b) Brier-loss training on neural models.
